_comment: PROVISIONAL. Written on 2026-09-13 from the field names of the bambulabs_api pinned in delivery/daemon/pyproject.toml and the OpenBambuAPI reference, because the shop H2S was not connected yet. Replace each block with a real capture from delivery/daemon/tests/hardware_smoke.py once the printer is on the LAN, then re-run make test in delivery/ and fix whatever the mapping got wrong. Each key below is one whole 'print' sub-document as bambulabs_api's mqtt_dump()['print'] returns it. The HMS severity rule map_status applies to these entries -- severity is (code >> 16) & 0xFFFF, and only 1 (fatal) or 2 (serious) turns the state into 'error' -- is provisional on the same capture: it comes from OpenBambuAPI's hms.md, not from bambulabs_api, which exposes no HMS accessor at all.
